ideas.idea: Server-render the blog list and give each post its own page/URL
ideas.why: The blog is client-fetched in useEffect, so moving it server-side and adding per-post URLs makes the content visible in HTML and linkable.

ideas.idea: Expand the pricing page with paid plan details
ideas.why: The page only says 'Free for up to three people' while its description promises plans for every team size.

ideas.idea: Expand the docs page beyond a single sentence with real setup steps
ideas.why: The docs page has one sentence while its description promises setup instructions, so readers and machines get little content.
This is accurate but would apply to almost any site, and the report itself hedges with 'if you want that'.

ideas.idea: Add links from the home page to pricing and docs
ideas.why: The nav already links to these pages from every page, so in-body links add little.

ideas.idea: Add <lastmod> to sitemap entries once real dates exist
ideas.why: This is standard sitemap advice that applies to any site and has little effect here.

ideas.idea: Remove the noindex from /pricing, or drop it from the sitemap and nav
ideas.why: This duplicates the known pricing noindex problem and is not a separate recommendation.
